blockers.title: Actual reward execution process is not bound to the declared isolated interpreter and package versions
blockers.detail: reward_smoke_small.run launches private workers using caller sys.executable. source_guard checks only spec identity/1800, and worker's witness validates a separate isolated subprocess. runpy then imports/trains in the original caller-derived worker without checking its own interpreter/Python/NumPy/Torch versions. Thus a different caller environment can satisfy source/plan/parent/argument checks and a successful isolated witness yet reach model imports with different packages. Preparation also uses unchecked caller NumPy. This is a static counterexample, not an actual launch.
blockers.required_disposition: Repair only the additive actual-process identity/version checks before model-bearing imports and enforce the preparation environment; preserve frozen scientific/numerical criteria and old evidence. New review is required for changed sources. Do not launch using this FAIL report.
